quest.title: The Floating Palace
quest.description: The mysterious emissary Ganyu appeared before you at Third-Round Knockout. Claiming to have come at Ningguang's behest, she invited you to the skyfaring palace known as the Jade Chamber. To that end, you and Paimon have come to Mt. Tianheng, from where you can see the Jade Chamber in the distance.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x675, Mora x27500, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, up there! That's the Jade Chamber.

choices.text: That's pretty high up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Uhh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, this is bad... Paimon's supposed to be your guide, but Paimon doesn't know where the way up to the Jade Chamber is...

choices.text: You're only realizing that now!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, since we want to go to the Jade Chamber, heading to its location on the map is the sensible thing to do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's look around. There has to be a way up there nearby!

choices.text: We should have asked that emissary, Ganyu.
Question is, how do we get up there?

talks.objective: Search for a way up to the Jade Chamber

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! There's some sort of mechanism thingy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since this is the right place, it must have something to do with the Jade Chamber.

choices.text: Maybe it's the way to the Jade Chamber?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, this must be the way!

choices.text: It looks like some sort of trap.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! Just trust Paimon's instincts!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It only takes us up to here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, if that wind current was stronger, we'd be able to reach the top in one go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best we go back to Liyue and ask the Millelith...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The way up shouldn't be a secret, or...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or? ...Oh, Paimon gets it! If it was a secret, Ganyu wouldn't have let us try to find it ourselves, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's follow your plan, then we can...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Hang on a moment. Look down there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we've gotten close to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Guizhong Ballista</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Uh... Paimon has a new idea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we shoot you up to the Jade Chamber using the Ballista?

choices.text: No thanks. I don't have a death wish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Right. This method does seem a bit unsafe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Still, I do remember that the Ballista had a scope.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, we could use the Guizhong Ballista to see if there's another way up nearby!

choices.text: Do you really hate me that much?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... No. Paimon may have just forgotten to think about the safety measures...

talks.objective: Head over to the Guizhong Ballista

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: Halt!

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: Who trespasses on these hallowed grounds?

choices.text: We're just passing through...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly. What're you talking about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're invited guests! What makes you think you can treat us like this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No... Wait... Maybe this was Ningguang's plan all along!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She pretended to invite us to the Jade Chamber, but set up a Millelith ambush here to arrest us!

choices.text: I'm quite sure that's not the case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grr... Now Paimon's mad! ...You! Over there! This is a trick, isn't it? How shameless!

response.speaker: Huaqing
response.text: What? We're just on guard duty. What do you mean, "shameless"?

response.speaker: Yang
response.text: What nonsense! Seize these suspicious intruders at once!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, here they come — line 'em up and knock 'em down!

choices.text: We haven't explained the invitation to them yet...
Hallowed what now? These are the wilds around Mt. Tianheng...

dialogues.text: Stop! What's all this about?

dialogues.speaker: Huaqing
dialogues.text: Lady Keqing, these two strange people suddenly appeared. They seem to have designs on the Guizhong Ballista.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who're you calling "strange"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We were just looking for the way to the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Hmm? You want to go to the Jade Chamber? Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're invited guests, here to look for the Liyue Qixing! Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well, as it happens, I am one of the Liyue Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'm Keqing, the Yuheng of the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I know of you, Traveler. You're Ningguang's guests, yes? Didn't expect to meet you here in the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Paimon didn't think we'd meet some super-rich big shot out here in the middle of nowhere, either.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The Guizhong Ballista in Tianheng Pass has long been in disrepair, and yet it was fixed in a single night. I came here to investigate that occurrence.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: These Millelith are just here to guard the scene, not to arrest anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, this was all a misunderstanding? Paimon never would've thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thinking isn't that hard, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Anyway, for a mortal to be able to repair an adepti mechanism is quite the mystery, even to the Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that was...

choices.text: (Shh, Paimon, don't complicate the matter!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Oh, right. So, Lady Yuheng, might you have any idea why Lady Tianquan invited us to go to the Jade Chamber?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Just call me Keqing.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'd say that Ningguang's purpose is to request that the savior of Mondstadt take a more neutral stance... Or at least, to not wholly side with the adepti.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're not taking sides. We spoke with the adepti. They want to protect Liyue as well...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: When you say "protect," you're referring to their sanctimonious arrogance, aren't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: You are mortals, and thus under their protection. There was no way they would have regarded you as someone with the ability to assassinate a god.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Naturally, they would also regard Ningguang's locking down the area, questioning the citizenry, and pursuit of the assassin to be pointless work. Perhaps they even wonder if there might be a cover-up.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'll say it like it is: they're underestimating us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you've got a point there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, this is the first time Paimon's seen a person from Liyue who doesn't respect the gods or the adepti.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hah. Should I respect the shallow sense of time and condescension to mortals that has caused them to delay in moving against us Qixing?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Forget it. I shouldn't speak of them this way. This skepticism is mine alone, and Ningguang does not share it.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Either way, I will admit that the actions of the adepti this time were quite restrained.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Rex Lapis' death is indeed an extraordinary circumstance. But to think that they would call for a council of adepti rather than come down here directly...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: How surprisingly civilized of them.

choices.text: Any chance you could talk it out with them?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Well, for Ningguang... She would talk anything and everything out if she could. But I doubt we can do that here.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The time of the adepti has long passed. If even the Liyue Qixing don't want to face that truth, then what future is there for Liyue?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew... Another super bold statement...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: *sigh* I'll stop here. Honestly, I hadn't intended to say so much. But you're a good listener, Traveler.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: You should both be off to the Jade Chamber. Don't be late, now. Ningguang's schedule is packed to the gills all the way till next year.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The cream of Liyue's mercantile crop all see "ascending to the Jade Chamber" as the greatest honor. Each brings rich gifts as they visit, all to curry a little favor with Ningguang.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Favor?

choices.text: Paimon, that's not the point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... But!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that's right! Greeting gifts are a staple of Liyue's culture. We need to get one, not to curry favor or anything — just to... respect Liyue's culture!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ah, so eager...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Alright, alright. You can decide on your greeting gift yourselves. Let me tell you how to get to the Jade Chamber first.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: You didn't actually have to come to Mt. Tianheng. Go back to Liyue Harbor, find a guide at the Yuehai Pavilion, and...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Well then. May we meet again, Traveler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that Yuheng may not respect the gods, but Paimon thinks she's a pretty cool person.

choices.text: She made a good impression on me, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... What should we give to Ningguang when we see her?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You really have shifted focus, haven't you, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Paimon dreamed of an amazing snack last night — <color=#00E1FFFF>Sugar-Frosted Slime!</color>

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon has a feeling that it would be perfect for a super rich person like Ningguang!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we go with that for a gift?

choices.text: So, do you have a recipe?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope! But Paimon's sure that we just need to make it with some boom shaka-laka!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go gather ingredients. Time waits for no one, and neither will our riches!

choices.text: And... how would we make this thing you dreamed up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With a certain boom shaka-laka, of course!

choices.text: I agree with some of her views.
Paimon, get serious.
Ningguang would prefer to negotiate, wouldn't she?
(We only did a tiny part of the work there...)
